description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Printer, which provides methods for rendering HTML elements, managing generator and configuration objects, and outputting HTML content with proper escaping and formatting. It serves as part of an HTML purification library, focusing on generating HTML output from tokens.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Printer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering HTML output from tokens, including methods for creating HTML elements, escaping strings, and formatting output. It interacts with generator and configuration objects to produce sanitized HTML content.

methods.description: Generates an end tag for an HTML element using the generator.
